security_layer.name: 0meg4kAI
security_layer.role: security, QA, tenant isolation, approval risk, and Omega runner guard

runner_layer.name: SkyeRunners
runner_layer.role: repo-aware runner orchestration with 0meg4kAI as security secondary for risky lanes

customer_front_door.name: Start Here
customer_front_door.upgrade_posture: Free value appears first. Ads, managed workspaces, custom mail domains, higher limits, commerce, video, content, and operator support appear as opt-in upgrade lanes.

browser_layer.name: 0S Browser
browser_layer.role: fullscreen installable browser shell for owned 0S apps, customer workspaces, offer lanes, and routed business tools
browser_layer.install_affordance: top-menu PWA button captures the browser install prompt and falls back to fullscreen when the prompt is unavailable
browser_layer.default_entry: after the logo entry, the launcher opens Start Here and the 0S Browser so customers land in a guided path instead of a raw app grid

capability_layer.name: SkyeAPI + AegisCore
capability_layer.role: provider-secret authority and AI/provider capability broker behind 0S gate cards
capability_layer.auth_rule: browser console uses MetrAIyuxGateBridge headers; backend admin and capability calls accept 0S/SkyGate gate-card context

document_layer.name: SkyeDocxMax / SovereignDocs
document_layer.role: document workspace, document AI, suite handoffs, and drive/mail/chat routing
document_layer.auth_rule: shared auth modules resolve through the 0S/SkyGate bridge, not local document tokens

rule: Apps inherit the 0S/SkyGate session and gate cards. They do not ask users for independent provider keys or overwrite the gate.
